name: Redundant Create buttons beside selection dropdowns
summary: Put the Create action inside the dropdown (type a new name, then Create) instead of adding a button beside it.
problem: A permanent "Create label" button next to the label select exposes an action that is relevant only when the right label is missing. It also grows every form that has a select.

bad.description: A select with a separate "Create label" button always visible next to it.

good.title: Create inside the dropdown
good.description: A searchable Dropdown with onCreate. Type a name with no match and a Create row appears exactly where it becomes relevant. Try it.

why: The action appears only when needed, in the place users are already looking, and uses the familiar select-or-create pattern.
exceptions: Creating the item needs a full form with several required fields, so a dialog launched from a menu entry is required.
A page whose purpose is managing the list itself (a labels settings page) needs its own Create button.

humanReview: Could the create action live in the dropdown without losing needed fields?
